@@ -82,6 +120,14 @@ u-boot-menu (4.0.5) unstable; urgency=medium

@@ -94,6 +140,25 @@ u-boot-menu (4.0.4) unstable; urgency=medium
 
  -- Jonas Smedegaard <dr@jones.dk>  Tue, 14 Dec 2021 13:38:06 +0100
 
+u-boot-menu (4.0.3ubuntu2) impish; urgency=medium
+
+  * Fix up merge conflicts in the previous upload.
+
+ -- Dimitri John Ledkov <xnox@ubuntu.com>  Fri, 07 May 2021 11:10:18 +0100
+
+u-boot-menu (4.0.3ubuntu1) impish; urgency=low
+
+  * Merge from Debian unstable. Remaining changes:
+    - Make default U_BOOT_PARAMETERS to be "ro earlycon". If one is using
+      embedded boards, most likely they want verbosity.
+    - Go back to generating fdtdir option in extlinux.conf, instead patch
+      u-boot qemu-riscv64_smode target to not process or load fdtdir
+      option.
+  * Dropped changes, included in Debian:
+    - u-boot-update: use PRETTY_NAME from os-release as menu label.
+
+ -- Steve Langasek <steve.langasek@ubuntu.com>  Wed, 28 Apr 2021 23:38:52 -0700
+
 u-boot-menu (4.0.3) unstable; urgency=medium
 
   [ Dimitri John Ledkov ]
@@ -108,6 +173,44 @@ u-boot-menu (4.0.3) unstable; urgency=medium
 
  -- Jonas Smedegaard <dr@jones.dk>  Thu, 19 Nov 2020 13:42:40 +0100
 
+u-boot-menu (4.0.2ubuntu5) hirsute; urgency=medium
+
+  * Go back to generating fdtdir option in extlinux.conf, instead patch
+    u-boot qemu-riscv64_smode target to not process or load fdtdir
+    option. Currently the dtb for riscv64 unmatched board in kernel &
+    u-boot are _unmatched_ meaning u-boot must use its dtb, and kernel
+    must use its dtb. Hence fdtdir option in extlinux.conf is
+    required. LP: #1925267 LP: #1923162
+
+ -- Dimitri John Ledkov <xnox@ubuntu.com>  Wed, 21 Apr 2021 03:32:22 +0100
+
+u-boot-menu (4.0.2ubuntu4) hirsute; urgency=medium
+
+  * Revert "Add support for ubuntu kernels location of device trees." as
+    it breaks booting riscv64 images with qemu, as the qemu in-ram dtb
+    should be used not the one from disk. LP: #1923162
+
+ -- Dimitri John Ledkov <xnox@ubuntu.com>  Mon, 12 Apr 2021 15:50:07 +0100
+
+u-boot-menu (4.0.2ubuntu3) hirsute; urgency=medium
+
+  * Add support for ubuntu kernels location of device trees.
+
+ -- Dimitri John Ledkov <xnox@ubuntu.com>  Tue, 16 Mar 2021 18:29:10 +0000
+
+u-boot-menu (4.0.2ubuntu2) hirsute; urgency=medium
+
+  * Make default U_BOOT_PARAMETERS to be "ro earlycon". If one is using
+    embedded boards, most likely they want verbosity.
+
+ -- Dimitri John Ledkov <xnox@ubuntu.com>  Tue, 24 Nov 2020 18:26:52 +0000
+
+u-boot-menu (4.0.2ubuntu1) hirsute; urgency=medium
+
+  * u-boot-update: use PRETTY_NAME from os-release as menu label.
+
+ -- Dimitri John Ledkov <xnox@ubuntu.com>  Thu, 19 Nov 2020 12:18:13 +0000
+
 u-boot-menu (4.0.2) unstable; urgency=medium
 
   [ Vagrant Cascadian ]

diff --git a/etc/default/u-boot b/etc/default/u-boot
index 002e532..8312ae6 100644
--- a/etc/default/u-boot
+++ b/etc/default/u-boot
@@ -7,11 +7,11 @@
 #U_BOOT_PROMPT="1"
 #U_BOOT_ENTRIES="all"

+#U_BOOT_PARAMETERS="ro earlycon"
 #U_BOOT_ROOT=""

diff --git a/read-config b/read-config
index d25edcc..176a780 100644
--- a/read-config
+++ b/read-config
@@ -53,7 +53,7 @@ else
 	# / and /boot are on the same filesystem
 	_BOOT_DIRECTORY="/boot"
 	_BOOT_PATH=""
-	_FDT_DIR="/usr/lib/linux-image-"
+	_FDT_DIR="/lib/firmware/"
 fi
 
 # Setting defaults if /etc/default/u-boot is missing
@@ -77,4 +77,4 @@ then
 		U_BOOT_ROOT="$(cat /etc/kernel/cmdline | sed -re 's/.*(root=[^[:space:]]*).*/\1/')"
 	fi
 fi
-U_BOOT_PARAMETERS="${U_BOOT_PARAMETERS:-ro quiet}"
+U_BOOT_PARAMETERS="${U_BOOT_PARAMETERS:-ro earlycon}"
diff --git a/u-boot-update b/u-boot-update
index 6b20e7f..40cb611 100755
--- a/u-boot-update
+++ b/u-boot-update
@@ -139,10 +139,13 @@ do
 	elif [ -e "${_BOOT_PATH}${U_BOOT_FDT_DIR}${_VERSION}/${U_BOOT_FDT}" ] && [ -n "${U_BOOT_FDT}" ]
 	then
 		_FDT="fdt ${U_BOOT_FDT_DIR}${_VERSION}/${U_BOOT_FDT}"
+	elif [ -d ${_BOOT_PATH}${U_BOOT_FDT_DIR}${_VERSION}/device-tree ]
+	then
+		_FDT="fdtdir ${U_BOOT_FDT_DIR}${_VERSION}/device-tree/"
 	elif [ -d "${_BOOT_PATH}${U_BOOT_FDT_DIR}${_VERSION}/" ]
 	then
 		_FDT="fdtdir ${U_BOOT_FDT_DIR}${_VERSION}/"
-	elif [ -f "${_BOOT_PATH}/${U_BOOT_FDT:-dtb-${_VERSION}}" ] && [ /usr/lib/linux-image- = "${U_BOOT_FDT_DIR}" ]
+	elif [ -f "${_BOOT_PATH}/${U_BOOT_FDT:-dtb-${_VERSION}}" ] && [ "/lib/firmware/" = "${U_BOOT_FDT_DIR}" ]
 	then
 		_FDT="fdt /${U_BOOT_FDT:-dtb-${_VERSION}}"
 	else
diff --git a/u-boot-update.8 b/u-boot-update.8
index 59aac48..9595c54 100644
--- a/u-boot-update.8
+++ b/u-boot-update.8
@@ -87,11 +87,11 @@ Value is an arbitrary string.
 If not specified, PRETTY_NAME from /etc/os\-release is used.
 Otherwise, it defaults to 'Debian GNU/Linux, kernel'.
 
-.IP "U_BOOT_PARAMETERS=""\fBro quiet\fR""" 4
+.IP "U_BOOT_PARAMETERS=""\fBro earlycon\fR""" 4
 This variable specifies additional boot parameters
 that are appended to each kernel entry.
 Value is an arbitrary string, default is the contents
-of /etc/kernel/cmdline, or 'ro quiet' (except for recovery
+of /etc/kernel/cmdline, or 'ro earlycon' (except for recovery
 entries, where quiet is avoided) if
 this file is not present or empty.
 
@@ -108,10 +108,10 @@ Values are in decisecond greater than 0
 0 specifies to wait forever.
 The default is 50.
 
-.IP "U_BOOT_FDT_DIR=""\fB/usr/lib/linux-image-\fR""" 4
+.IP "U_BOOT_FDT_DIR=""\fB/lib/firmware/\fR""" 4
 This variable specifies the unversioned stem of paths
 where U\-BOOT should look for the flattened device tree binaries.
-Default is '/usr/lib/linux-image-'. When U_BOOT_SYNC_DTBS is true
+Default is '/lib/firmware/'. When U_BOOT_SYNC_DTBS is true
 and u\-boot\-update detects /boot is on a separate partition, the
 default value is then '/dtb-'.
